dialogue.text: Hello, fearless knowledge seekers. Welcome to today in history for 24 March.
dialogue.zh: 你好，無畏的知識探索者。歡迎來到3月24日的歷史今天。
dialogue.ja: こんにちは、勇敢な知識探求者の皆さん。3月24日の歴史へようこそ。
dialogue.local: Hello, fearless knowledge seekers. Welcome to today in history for 24 March.
dialogue.en: Hello, fearless knowledge seekers. Welcome to today in history for 24 March.

dialogue.text: We've dug up 20 riveting events guaranteed to blow your mind or fuel your next trivia Smackdown.
dialogue.zh: 我們挖掘了20個扣人心弦的事件，保證讓你大開眼界或助你在下一場知識競賽中大放異彩。
dialogue.ja: 心を揺さぶる20の出来事を掘り起こしました。あなたの驚きを保証し、次のトリビア対決を盛り上げます。
dialogue.local: We've dug up 20 riveting events guaranteed to blow your mind or fuel your next trivia Smackdown.
dialogue.en: We've dug up 20 riveting events guaranteed to blow your mind or fuel your next trivia Smackdown.

dialogue.text: If juicy, lesser-known tales are your jam, smash that subscribe button now.
dialogue.zh: 如果你喜歡那些鮮為人知的精彩故事，現在就點擊訂閱吧。
dialogue.ja: もし知られざる面白い話が好きなら、今すぐチャンネル登録を押してください。
dialogue.local: If juicy, lesser-known tales are your jam, smash that subscribe button now.
dialogue.en: If juicy, lesser-known tales are your jam, smash that subscribe button now.

dialogue.text: Ready to time travel across centuries in a single breath? Buckle up, because these stories might just change everything.
dialogue.zh: 準備好一口氣穿越數個世紀的時光旅行了嗎？繫好安全帶，這些故事可能會改變一切。
dialogue.ja: 一息で何世紀も旅する準備はできましたか？シートベルトを締めてください。これらの物語はすべてを変えるかもしれません。
dialogue.local: Ready to time travel across centuries in a single breath? Buckle up, because these stories might just change everything.
dialogue.en: Ready to time travel across centuries in a single breath? Buckle up, because these stories might just change everything.

dialogue.text: Number 20. On 24 March 1603, Queen Elizabeth I of England died at Richmond Palace, paving the throne's way to James VI of Scotland. The Tudor era ended and the Stuart dynasty rose.
dialogue.zh: 第20件事。1603年3月24日，英格蘭的伊莉莎白一世女王在里士滿宮去世，為蘇格蘭的詹姆斯六世登基鋪路。都鐸王朝結束，斯圖亞特王朝興起。
dialogue.ja: 第20位。1603年3月24日、イングランドのエリザベス1世女王がリッチモンド宮殿で亡くなり、スコットランドのジェームズ6世が王位を継ぎました。チューダー朝が終わり、ステュアート朝が始まりました。
dialogue.local: Number 20. On 24 March 1603, Queen Elizabeth I of England died at Richmond Palace, paving the throne's way to James VI of Scotland. The Tudor era ended and the Stuart dynasty rose.
dialogue.en: Number 20. On 24 March 1603, Queen Elizabeth I of England died at Richmond Palace, paving the throne's way to James VI of Scotland. The Tudor era ended and the Stuart dynasty rose.

dialogue.text: Number 19. On 24 March 1721, Johann Sebastian Bach dedicated his Brandenburg concertos to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg Schvet. Though initially overlooked, these six masterworks ultimately dazzled future generations with their intricate brilliance.
dialogue.zh: 第19件事。1721年3月24日，約翰·塞巴斯蒂安·巴赫將他的布蘭登堡協奏曲獻給布蘭登堡-施韋特的邁克格拉夫克里斯蒂安·路德維希。雖然最初被忽視，這六部傑作最終以其精妙的光輝令後代驚嘆。
dialogue.ja: 第19位。1721年3月24日、ヨハン・ゼバスティアン・バッハはブランデンブルクの辺境伯クリスティアン・ルートヴィヒにブランデンブルク協奏曲を献呈しました。最初は見過ごされましたが、これら6つの傑作は後世を魅了しました。
dialogue.local: Number 19. On 24 March 1721, Johann Sebastian Bach dedicated his Brandenburg concertos to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg Schvet. Though initially overlooked, these six masterworks ultimately dazzled future generations with their intricate brilliance.
dialogue.en: Number 19. On 24 March 1721, Johann Sebastian Bach dedicated his Brandenburg concertos to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg Schvet. Though initially overlooked, these six masterworks ultimately dazzled future generations with their intricate brilliance.

dialogue.text: Number 18. On 24 March 1765, the British Parliament passed the Quartering Act, forcing American colonists to house and supply British troops. Enraged colonists saw it as another stepping stone toward revolution.
dialogue.zh: 第18件事。1765年3月24日，英國議會通過了《住宿法案》，強迫美國殖民者為英軍提供住宿和補給。憤怒的殖民者視此為通往革命的又一階梯。
dialogue.ja: 第18位。1765年3月24日、イギリス議会は宿営法を可決し、アメリカ植民者にイギリス軍の宿泊と補給を強制しました。植民者はこれを革命への一歩と見なしました。
dialogue.local: Number 18. On 24 March 1765, the British Parliament passed the Quartering Act, forcing American colonists to house and supply British troops. Enraged colonists saw it as another stepping stone toward revolution.
dialogue.en: Number 18. On 24 March 1765, the British Parliament passed the Quartering Act, forcing American colonists to house and supply British troops. Enraged colonists saw it as another stepping stone toward revolution.

dialogue.text: Number 17. On 24 March 1832, Mormon founder Joseph Smith Jr. was brutally tarred and feathered by vigilantes in Hiram, Ohio, underscoring the violent resistance to his budding religious movement.
dialogue.zh: 第17件事。1832年3月24日，摩門教創始人約瑟夫·史密斯在俄亥俄州海勒姆被義勇隊殘忍地塗焦油和羽毛，凸顯了對他新興宗教運動的暴力抵抗。
dialogue.ja: 第17位。1832年3月24日、モルモン教の創始者ジョセフ・スミス・ジュニアはオハイオ州ハイラムで自警団に残酷にタールと羽で覆われました。彼の宗教運動への激しい抵抗を示しています。
dialogue.local: Number 17. On 24 March 1832, Mormon founder Joseph Smith Jr. was brutally tarred and feathered by vigilantes in Hiram, Ohio, underscoring the violent resistance to his budding religious movement.
dialogue.en: Number 17. On 24 March 1832, Mormon founder Joseph Smith Jr. was brutally tarred and feathered by vigilantes in Hiram, Ohio, underscoring the violent resistance to his budding religious movement.

dialogue.text: Number 16. On 24 March 1860, the Treaty of Turin ceded Savoy and niece from the Kingdom of Sardinia to France, reshaping Europe's map and paving the way for Italian unification progress.
dialogue.zh: 第16件事。1860年3月24日，杜林條約將薩沃伊和尼斯從薩丁尼亞王國割讓給法國，重塑了歐洲地圖，為義大利統一鋪平道路。
dialogue.ja: 第16位。1860年3月24日、トリノ条約によりサヴォイアとニースがサルデーニャ王国からフランスに割譲され、ヨーロッパの地図が変わり、イタリア統一への道が開かれました。
dialogue.local: Number 16. On 24 March 1860, the Treaty of Turin ceded Savoy and niece from the Kingdom of Sardinia to France, reshaping Europe's map and paving the way for Italian unification progress.
dialogue.en: Number 16. On 24 March 1860, the Treaty of Turin ceded Savoy and niece from the Kingdom of Sardinia to France, reshaping Europe's map and paving the way for Italian unification progress.

dialogue.text: Number 15. On 24 March 1878, the British Training Ship HMS Uritacy sank off the Isle of White in a sudden snowstorm, killing over 300 sailors and horrifying Queen Victoria's maritime nation.
dialogue.zh: 第15件事。1878年3月24日，英國訓練船HMS Uritacy在懷特島附近突遇暴風雪沉沒，造成超過300名水手喪生，震驚了維多利亞女王的海洋國家。
dialogue.ja: 第15位。1878年3月24日、英国の訓練船HMSユリタシーがホワイト島沖で突然の吹雪に遭い沈没し、300人以上の水兵が亡くなり、ヴィクトリア女王の海洋国家を震撼させました。
dialogue.local: Number 15. On 24 March 1878, the British Training Ship HMS Uritacy sank off the Isle of White in a sudden snowstorm, killing over 300 sailors and horrifying Queen Victoria's maritime nation.
dialogue.en: Number 15. On 24 March 1878, the British Training Ship HMS Uritacy sank off the Isle of White in a sudden snowstorm, killing over 300 sailors and horrifying Queen Victoria's maritime nation.

dialogue.text: Number 14. On 24 March 1882, Dr. Robert Koch announced his discovery of mycobacterium tuberculosis, the TB causing bacterium. This breakthrough revolutionized medicine and launched new attacks against one of history's worst killers.
dialogue.zh: 第14件事。1882年3月24日，羅伯特·科赫博士宣布發現結核分枝桿菌，這種細菌引發結核病。這一突破革新了醫學，開啟了對歷史上最致命殺手之一的新攻擊。
dialogue.ja: 第14位。1882年3月24日、ローベルト・コッホ博士が結核菌を発見したと発表しました。この発見は医学を革命的に変え、歴史上最悪の殺人者の一つに対する新たな攻撃を開始しました。
dialogue.local: Number 14. On 24 March 1882, Dr. Robert Koch announced his discovery of mycobacterium tuberculosis, the TB causing bacterium. This breakthrough revolutionized medicine and launched new attacks against one of history's worst killers.
dialogue.en: Number 14. On 24 March 1882, Dr. Robert Koch announced his discovery of mycobacterium tuberculosis, the TB causing bacterium. This breakthrough revolutionized medicine and launched new attacks against one of history's worst killers.

dialogue.text: Number 13. On 24 March 1900, mayor of New York City, Robert Van Waik, ceremonially opened the first section of the city's underground rapid transit railroad, a pivotal step in modern subway evolution.
dialogue.zh: 第13件事。1900年3月24日，紐約市長羅伯特·范·懷克正式啟用了城市地下快速鐵路的第一段，這是現代地鐵發展的重要一步。
dialogue.ja: 第13位。1900年3月24日、ニューヨーク市長ロバート・ヴァン・ワイクが市の地下高速鉄道の最初の区間を式典で開通させ、現代地下鉄の進化における重要な一歩となりました。
dialogue.local: Number 13. On 24 March 1900, mayor of New York City, Robert Van Waik, ceremonially opened the first section of the city's underground rapid transit railroad, a pivotal step in modern subway evolution.
dialogue.en: Number 13. On 24 March 1900, mayor of New York City, Robert Van Waik, ceremonially opened the first section of the city's underground rapid transit railroad, a pivotal step in modern subway evolution.

dialogue.text: Number 12. On 24 March 1905, Jules Verne died in Amiens, France, leaving behind visionary novels like 20,000 leagues under the sea that shaped science fiction and sparked countless wild imaginations.
dialogue.zh: 第12件事。1905年3月24日，儒勒·凡爾納在法國亞眠去世，留下了《海底兩萬里》等富有遠見的小說，塑造了科幻文學並激發無數狂野想像。
dialogue.ja: 第12位。1905年3月24日、ジュール・ヴェルヌがフランスのアミアンで亡くなりました。彼の『海底二万里』などの先見的な小説はSFを形作り、多くの想像力を刺激しました。
dialogue.local: Number 12. On 24 March 1905, Jules Verne died in Amiens, France, leaving behind visionary novels like 20,000 leagues under the sea that shaped science fiction and sparked countless wild imaginations.
dialogue.en: Number 12. On 24 March 1905, Jules Verne died in Amiens, France, leaving behind visionary novels like 20,000 leagues under the sea that shaped science fiction and sparked countless wild imaginations.

dialogue.text: Number 11. On 24 March 1934, the Titans McDuffie Act promised Philippine independence after a decade-long transition, heralding a shift from U.S. colonial rule to hopes of self-governance in the Pacific archipelago.
dialogue.zh: 第11件事。1934年3月24日，泰坦斯·麥克達菲法案承諾在十年過渡期後菲律賓獨立，預示著從美國殖民統治向太平洋群島自我治理的轉變。
dialogue.ja: 第11位。1934年3月24日、タイタンズ・マクダフィー法により、10年の移行期間を経てフィリピンの独立が約束され、米国の植民地支配から太平洋の島々の自治への転換が始まりました。
dialogue.local: Number 11. On 24 March 1934, the Titans McDuffie Act promised Philippine independence after a decade-long transition, heralding a shift from U.S. colonial rule to hopes of self-governance in the Pacific archipelago.
dialogue.en: Number 11. On 24 March 1934, the Titans McDuffie Act promised Philippine independence after a decade-long transition, heralding a shift from U.S. colonial rule to hopes of self-governance in the Pacific archipelago.

dialogue.text: Number 10. On 24 March 1944, 76 Allied POWs crawled out from Stalagloft III in the Great Escape. Though most were recaptured, their audacious breakout displayed undaunted ingenuity under Nazi captivity.
dialogue.zh: 第10件事。1944年3月24日，76名盟軍戰俘從斯塔拉格洛夫特三號集中營爬出，進行了大逃亡。雖然大多數被重新捕獲，但他們大膽的逃脫展現了在納粹囚禁下不屈不撓的智慧。
dialogue.ja: 第10位。1944年3月24日、76人の連合軍捕虜がスタラグロフトIIIから脱走しました。多くは再捕されましたが、その大胆な脱出はナチスの捕虜生活での不屈の知恵を示しました。
dialogue.local: Number 10. On 24 March 1944, 76 Allied POWs crawled out from Stalagloft III in the Great Escape. Though most were recaptured, their audacious breakout displayed undaunted ingenuity under Nazi captivity.
dialogue.en: Number 10. On 24 March 1944, 76 Allied POWs crawled out from Stalagloft III in the Great Escape. Though most were recaptured, their audacious breakout displayed undaunted ingenuity under Nazi captivity.

dialogue.text: Number 9. On 24 March 1958, Elvis Presley was inducted into the U.S. Army at Fort Chaffee, Arkansas. Temporarily pausing his rock and roll reign and sending teenage fans into heartbreak.
dialogue.zh: 第9件事。1958年3月24日，埃爾維斯·普雷斯利在阿肯色州查菲堡入伍美軍，暫時中斷了他的搖滾王朝，令青少年粉絲心碎。
dialogue.ja: 第9位。1958年3月24日、エルヴィス・プレスリーがアーカンソー州フォートチャフィーで米軍に入隊し、ロックンロールの王座を一時中断し、ティーンのファンを悲しませました。
dialogue.local: Number 9. On 24 March 1958, Elvis Presley was inducted into the U.S. Army at Fort Chaffee, Arkansas. Temporarily pausing his rock and roll reign and sending teenage fans into heartbreak.
dialogue.en: Number 9. On 24 March 1958, Elvis Presley was inducted into the U.S. Army at Fort Chaffee, Arkansas. Temporarily pausing his rock and roll reign and sending teenage fans into heartbreak.

dialogue.text: Number 8. On 24 March 1976, a military coup in Argentina overthrew President Isabel Perron, initiating a brutal dictatorship notorious for disappearances, launching the country's darkest chapter of repression and fear.
dialogue.zh: 第8件事。1976年3月24日，阿根廷軍事政變推翻總統伊莎貝爾·佩隆，開啟了以失蹤事件聞名的殘酷獨裁時期，揭開該國最黑暗的壓迫與恐懼篇章。
dialogue.ja: 第8位。1976年3月24日、アルゼンチンで軍事クーデターが起こり、イサベル・ペロン大統領が追放され、失踪事件で悪名高い残酷な独裁政権が始まりました。国の最も暗い弾圧と恐怖の時代の幕開けです。
dialogue.local: Number 8. On 24 March 1976, a military coup in Argentina overthrew President Isabel Perron, initiating a brutal dictatorship notorious for disappearances, launching the country's darkest chapter of repression and fear.
dialogue.en: Number 8. On 24 March 1976, a military coup in Argentina overthrew President Isabel Perron, initiating a brutal dictatorship notorious for disappearances, launching the country's darkest chapter of repression and fear.

dialogue.text: Number 7. On 24 March 1980, Archbishop Oscar Romero of El Salvador was assassinated while celebrating mass. His outspoken defense of human rights turned him into a martyr for justice across Latin America.
dialogue.zh: 第7件事。1980年3月24日，薩爾瓦多大主教奧斯卡·羅梅羅在主持彌撒時被暗殺。他直言不諱地捍衛人權，使他成為拉丁美洲正義的殉道者。
dialogue.ja: 第7位。1980年3月24日、エルサルバドルのオスカー・ロメロ大司教がミサを執り行っている最中に暗殺されました。彼の人権擁護はラテンアメリカ全体で正義の殉教者とされました。
dialogue.local: Number 7. On 24 March 1980, Archbishop Oscar Romero of El Salvador was assassinated while celebrating mass. His outspoken defense of human rights turned him into a martyr for justice across Latin America.
dialogue.en: Number 7. On 24 March 1980, Archbishop Oscar Romero of El Salvador was assassinated while celebrating mass. His outspoken defense of human rights turned him into a martyr for justice across Latin America.

dialogue.text: Number 6. On 24 March 1989, the Exxon Valdez tanker ran aground in Alaska's Prince William Sound, spilling 11 million gallons of crude oil and igniting a firestorm of environmental accountability demands.
dialogue.zh: 第6件事。1989年3月24日，埃克森瓦爾迪茲油輪在阿拉斯加威廉王子灣擱淺，洩漏1100萬加侖原油，引發環境責任要求的風暴。
dialogue.ja: 第6位。1989年3月24日、エクソン・ヴァルディーズのタンカーがアラスカのプリンス・ウィリアム湾で座礁し、1100万ガロンの原油を流出させ、環境責任を求める大騒動を引き起こしました。
dialogue.local: Number 6. On 24 March 1989, the Exxon Valdez tanker ran aground in Alaska's Prince William Sound, spilling 11 million gallons of crude oil and igniting a firestorm of environmental accountability demands.
dialogue.en: Number 6. On 24 March 1989, the Exxon Valdez tanker ran aground in Alaska's Prince William Sound, spilling 11 million gallons of crude oil and igniting a firestorm of environmental accountability demands.

dialogue.text: Number 5. On 24 March 1999, NATO Warplanes launched air strikes against Yugoslavia over Kosovo by passing the UN. The controversial bombing campaign spurred fierce debates on sovereignty, human rights, and modern conflict interventions.
dialogue.zh: 第5件事。1999年3月24日，北約戰機在未經聯合國批准下對南斯拉夫科索沃發動空襲。這場有爭議的轟炸行動引發了關於主權、人權和現代衝突干預的激烈辯論。
dialogue.ja: 第5位。1999年3月24日、NATOの戦闘機が国連を通さずにコソボをめぐりユーゴスラビアに空爆を開始しました。この物議を醸す爆撃は主権、人権、現代の紛争介入について激しい議論を呼びました。
dialogue.local: Number 5. On 24 March 1999, NATO Warplanes launched air strikes against Yugoslavia over Kosovo by passing the UN. The controversial bombing campaign spurred fierce debates on sovereignty, human rights, and modern conflict interventions.
dialogue.en: Number 5. On 24 March 1999, NATO Warplanes launched air strikes against Yugoslavia over Kosovo by passing the UN. The controversial bombing campaign spurred fierce debates on sovereignty, human rights, and modern conflict interventions.

dialogue.text: Number 4. On 24 March 2000, the dot-com bubble burst as the Nasdaq composite peaked then crumbled. E-commerce darlings imploded, fueling cautionary tales of speculation, get rich quick illusions, and epic tech meltdown infamy.
dialogue.zh: 第4件事。2000年3月24日，隨著納斯達克綜合指數達到頂峰後崩潰，網路泡沫破裂。電子商務明星企業崩潰，引發了關於投機、快速致富幻象和科技崩盤的警示故事。
dialogue.ja: 第4位。2000年3月24日、ナスダック総合指数がピークに達した後に崩壊し、ドットコムバブルがはじけました。電子商取引の有望企業が倒れ、投機や一攫千金の幻想、巨大な技術崩壊の悪名を警告する物語が生まれました。
dialogue.local: Number 4. On 24 March 2000, the dot-com bubble burst as the Nasdaq composite peaked then crumbled. E-commerce darlings imploded, fueling cautionary tales of speculation, get rich quick illusions, and epic tech meltdown infamy.
dialogue.en: Number 4. On 24 March 2000, the dot-com bubble burst as the Nasdaq composite peaked then crumbled. E-commerce darlings imploded, fueling cautionary tales of speculation, get rich quick illusions, and epic tech meltdown infamy.

dialogue.text: Number 3. On 24 March 2008, Bhutan held its first ever general election, emerging from absolute monarchy. This peaceful shift to democracy astonished confirming that even the land of happiness craves ballots.
dialogue.zh: 第3件事。2008年3月24日，不丹舉行了首次全民大選，結束了絕對君主制。這和平的民主轉型令人驚訝，證明即使是幸福之國也渴望選票。
dialogue.ja: 第3位。2008年3月24日、ブータンは初の総選挙を実施し、絶対君主制から脱却しました。この平和的な民主主義への移行は、幸福の国でさえ投票を求めていることを示しました。
dialogue.local: Number 3. On 24 March 2008, Bhutan held its first ever general election, emerging from absolute monarchy. This peaceful shift to democracy astonished confirming that even the land of happiness craves ballots.
dialogue.en: Number 3. On 24 March 2008, Bhutan held its first ever general election, emerging from absolute monarchy. This peaceful shift to democracy astonished confirming that even the land of happiness craves ballots.

dialogue.text: Number 2. On 24 March 2015, Germanwings flight 9525 crashed in the French Alps, deliberately downed by its co-pilot. The tragic event killed all 150 aboard and shook confidence in flight security.
dialogue.zh: 第2件事。2015年3月24日，德國漢莎航空9525號班機在法國阿爾卑斯山墜毀，系副駕駛故意造成。這場悲劇造成機上150人全部罹難，動搖了飛行安全的信心。
dialogue.ja: 第2位。2015年3月24日、ドイツウィングス9525便がフランスのアルプスで墜落し、副操縦士による故意の事故でした。この悲劇で乗客150人全員が亡くなり、航空安全への信頼が揺らぎました。
dialogue.local: Number 2. On 24 March 2015, Germanwings flight 9525 crashed in the French Alps, deliberately downed by its co-pilot. The tragic event killed all 150 aboard and shook confidence in flight security.
dialogue.en: Number 2. On 24 March 2015, Germanwings flight 9525 crashed in the French Alps, deliberately downed by its co-pilot. The tragic event killed all 150 aboard and shook confidence in flight security.

dialogue.text: Number 1. On 24 March 2020, India's Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced a 21-day lockdown for 1.3 billion people, aiming to stem COVID-19 spread and launching an unprecedented logistical challenge worldwide.
dialogue.zh: 第1件事。2020年3月24日，印度總理納倫德拉·莫迪宣布對13億人口實施為期21天的封鎖，旨在遏制COVID-19的傳播，並引發全球前所未有的物流挑戰。
dialogue.ja: 第1位。2020年3月24日、インドのナレンドラ・モディ首相は13億人を対象に21日間のロックダウンを発表し、COVID-19の拡散を抑え、世界的に前例のない物流の課題をもたらしました。
dialogue.local: Number 1. On 24 March 2020, India's Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced a 21-day lockdown for 1.3 billion people, aiming to stem COVID-19 spread and launching an unprecedented logistical challenge worldwide.
dialogue.en: Number 1. On 24 March 2020, India's Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced a 21-day lockdown for 1.3 billion people, aiming to stem COVID-19 spread and launching an unprecedented logistical challenge worldwide.

dialogue.text: There you have it, 24 March in all its chaotic, visionary glory. If these stories hit you like a thunderbolt of wow, go ahead and subscribe.
dialogue.zh: 以上就是3月24日所有混亂而富有遠見的光輝。如果這些故事讓你驚嘆不已，請訂閱我們。
dialogue.ja: これで3月24日の混沌とした、かつ先見の明に満ちた栄光をお伝えしました。もしこれらの話に感動したら、ぜひチャンネル登録してください。
dialogue.local: There you have it, 24 March in all its chaotic, visionary glory. If these stories hit you like a thunderbolt of wow, go ahead and subscribe.
dialogue.en: There you have it, 24 March in all its chaotic, visionary glory. If these stories hit you like a thunderbolt of wow, go ahead and subscribe.

dialogue.text: Tomorrow's date promises more intrigue, rebellions, fiasco's, revelations, you name it, so keep your time travel goggles handy.
dialogue.zh: 明天的日期將帶來更多陰謀、叛亂、災難和啟示，應有盡有，請隨時準備好你的時光旅行護目鏡。
dialogue.ja: 明日はもっと多くの陰謀、反乱、失敗、啓示が待っています。だからタイムトラベル用のゴーグルを用意しておいてください。
dialogue.local: Tomorrow's date promises more intrigue, rebellions, fiasco's, revelations, you name it, so keep your time travel goggles handy.
dialogue.en: Tomorrow's date promises more intrigue, rebellions, fiasco's, revelations, you name it, so keep your time travel goggles handy.

dialogue.text: Don't let history's next epic slip by. Join us in on Earthing new wonders because the best jaw droppers are often the ones nobody sees coming.
dialogue.zh: 不要讓歷史的下一個史詩錯過。加入我們一起探索新奇，因為最令人驚嘆的往往是那些沒有人預料到的。
dialogue.ja: 歴史の次の壮大な出来事を見逃さないでください。私たちと一緒に新たな驚きを発見しましょう。最高の驚きは、予想外のものだからです。
dialogue.local: Don't let history's next epic slip by. Join us in on Earthing new wonders because the best jaw droppers are often the ones nobody sees coming.
dialogue.en: Don't let history's next epic slip by. Join us in on Earthing new wonders because the best jaw droppers are often the ones nobody sees coming.

dialogue.text: Ready for more? We'll see you then.
dialogue.zh: 準備好迎接更多了嗎？我們到時見。
dialogue.ja: もっと知りたいですか？それではまた。
